{{Quote|Today, I stood with the proud people of Okyaab 6 as they threw off the shackles of their Mandalorian slavers and rose to join the Republic.|Propaganda broadcast by "Captain Goodvalor"|<ref name="Interference" />}}
'''Okyaab 6''' was a supposed [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]]. According to a [[3963 BBY]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] broadcast by the "[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Benegryph Goodvalor|Goodvalor]]" persona, Okyaab 6 had been conquered by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] but, after less than a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] rule, the local [[Okyaabi]] residents had risen up against them and reclaimed the planet, subsequently joining the Republic.

==Description==
Okyaab 6, also referred to simply as Okyaab, was supposedly a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Interference" /> in the [[Okyaab system/Legends|Okyaab system]], a part of the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Quote|And, no, I've never heard of a planet named Okyaab. Does it have to do with getting me the parts I asked for?|Transmission by Koblus Sornell|<ref name="Interference" />}}
[[File:Koblus_Sornell.png|thumb|right|300px|Koblus Sornell (pictured) had not been aware of the existence of the supposed planet Okyaab 6 before hearing "Captain Goodvalor's" propaganda broadcast.]]
By [[3963 BBY]], the Okyaab [[Star system/Legends|system]] was situated outside of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusader]] faction of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture.<ref name="TEA" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Okyaab 6 was mentioned in a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] broadcast&mdash;targeting the Mandalorians, that state's enemy in the ongoing [[Mandalorian Wars]], and liberally incorporating both exaggerations and untruths&mdash;by "[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Benegryph Goodvalor|Goodvalor]],"<ref name="Interference" /> who, in reality, was a persona performed by the [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Marn Hierogryph's brother|brother]] of the accidental Republic hero [[Marn Hierogryph]].<ref name="KOTOR47">[[Knights of the Old Republic 47|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 47]]</ref>

"Goodvalor" claimed that Okyaab 6, or Okyaab, was a world that had previously been in contact with the Republic but, despite its low profile, had been conquered by the Neo-Crusaders. According to "Goodvalor," however, after less than a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] of Mandalorian rule over the planet, its [[Okyaabi]] inhabitants had risen up against the occupiers and reclaimed their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], with the Republic captain personally witnessing the event and, to his knowledge, no Mandalorian survivors remaining there. After the broadcast, the Mandalorian signals expert [[Koblus Sornell]]&mdash;who had grown annoyed by "Goodvalor's" previous broadcasts&mdash;noted in response to a previous query during a transmission<ref name="Interference" /> she<ref name="War 1">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 1|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 1]]</ref> was sending to other Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] that she had not been aware of the existence of a planet named Okyaab.<ref name="Interference" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|A small frontier system, to be sure &mdash; but proof of the pettiness of Mandalore, as no peaceful farming community, no collection of artisans is too small to merit one of his cowardly attacks.|Propaganda broadcast by "Captain Goodvalor"|<ref name="Interference" />}}
"Captain Goodvalor" characterized Okyaab 6 as a small frontier world that was home to the Okyaabi, a peaceful community of [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] and [[Artisan/Legends|artisans]] that also engaged in Galactic Republic commerce.<ref name="Interference" />

==Behind the scenes==
Okyaab 6 was introduced in "[[Interference]]," a [[2008]] short story written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and published on [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]].<ref name="Interference" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Okyaab system, and thereby Okyaab 6, in grid square N-7.<ref name="TEA" />
